requirements.technical_identity: Natural technical research keeps technical_research intent and uses company_research executor when enabled.
requirements.strict_scope: Explicit only indicators forbid implicit ATR and unrequested MA20/MA60; only technical forbids company reads.
requirements.indicator_edit: Shared-result add/replace/remove/window commands preserve subject, dates and other indicators; ambiguous targets clarify before reads.
requirements.history: History follows the latest result storage and performs no model or source calls.
requirements.legacy: Existing legacy pending/edit, explicit APIs, knowledge and disabled company capability retain their owners.
requirements.failure: Failed or cancelled research never restores an earlier current subject or publishes partial state.
requirements.baseline: Freeze all 117 original inputs, preserve original observers and v1-v5, explain every changed field including propagated state.
